system.longDesc:
Like dart ammo (previously) except taser darts contain high-density batteries designed to deliver a powerful electric shock to the target. They function like the stun gun described in Chapter 4 of the Modern AGE Basic Rulebook, except they do not require the trailing wires, being self-contained, and have a greater range. Taser darts require a weapon specially designed to fire them and are not interchangeable with other types of ammo.

Resources TN 7.
